scope: Sole canonical state transport and runtime; retire disabled V0 wire/API families
implementation: Protocol exposes only context-bound canonical state frames. Runtime exposes only full-state scheduling, delivery, proof fetch and history catch-up.

Retired acquisition/serving and artifact/block/head/candidate/recovery/consensus-push/finality-only transports, messages, public APIs and dedicated tests. Canonical mode already disabled those negotiations; no new format or deterministic rule change.
Transport retains limits/allowlist/sessions/state behavior order, Noise, Yamux, fixed dial ownership, bounded retry and exactly the same connection, stream, timeout and custody limits.
Pending keys explicitly pair peer identity and per-peer request id. Network-instance identity, request digest, response kind and permit lifetime are unchanged.
Shared consensus-reservation/background and application-response throttles belonged only to removed legacy exchanges; canonical paths did not use them.

Windows authoring snapshot now compares empty regular .lock files by presence, size and modification time, avoiding forbidden reads of held byte-range locks. Journal/anchor bytes remain compared exactly on every platform.

replacement_coverage.unchanged_canonical: All state exchange codec/custody/boundary, protocol vectors, runtime intake/timing/proof-fetch, full-state process and devnet suites remain active.
replacement_coverage.shared_session: Static configuration bounds, wrong dial direction, stale managed dial, limit-before-preauthentication budget, session retry and token-bucket tests remain.
replacement_coverage.new_lifecycle: Actual Noise bidirectional correlation; same request id across two peers; retained inbound peer isolation; foreign-network ticket with same peer/id/digest; duplicate terminal; dropped ticket/event; closed channel; wrong/unlisted Noise identities; static retry and reconnect.
replacement_coverage.aggregate_bound: Eight shared permits filled directly, with a real retained response occupying one slot until drop. This is exact budget coverage, not an eight-peer live network experiment.
replacement_coverage.retired_only: Legacy artifacts/blocks/heads/candidate stores, V0 full-envelope handoff, auxiliary runtime journal codecs and their source-specific integration tests are removed with those APIs. They no longer define an executable transport authority.
